_comment: Topic blacklists were replaced by level-aware vocabulary complexity. Keep this file as policy documentation for non-engineers.

complexity_rules.A1: daily life only, simple high-frequency words
complexity_rules.A2: daily life plus simple appointments, directions, and basic health
complexity_rules.B1: health, work, services, and longer practical conversations
complexity_rules.B2: general public life, abstract topics, finance, politics, and nuanced discussion

decision_model: Reject only when vocabulary complexity is above the student's CEFR level. Do not reject because of the topic name alone.
